claims.text: The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged. The trip_record, the gps_trace and the fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-00106, and the trace's first fix at 2026-07-17T08:35:15+08:00 matches trip_record.started_at, so the three artifacts describe the same trip; the same trace then yields an excess that clears the POL-RD-01 establishment test.

Actual distance is taken from the governing field gps_trace.trace_distance_km of 10.78 km, not from the rounded 10.8 km convenience copy on the trip_record, and the booked optimal is 7.2 km. The excess of 3.58 km is greater than 20% of optimal (1.44 km) AND greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms, so the route deviation is ESTABLISHED under POL-RD-01 on both limbs.

The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes: 169 fixes at a 10 second sampling interval, 100% coverage, an empty gaps list and max_gap_sec of 0.0. None of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) fires, so the deviation may be established on the gps_trace alone and no independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) is required.

The trace's own ERP crossings place the vehicle on the CTE, a corridor the optimal route does not use: the nearest fixes are 0.0 m from the Braddell Rd gantry at 08:40:55 and 24.1 m from the Chin Swee tunnel gantry at 08:52:45, and both gantry lines are flagged on_optimal_route false because the booked optimal (Thomson Rd to Bukit Timah Rd to Rochor Canal Rd) carries no gantry and 0.00 ERP.

The fare model is METERED, so the refund is arithmetic rather than discretionary. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 7.2 optimal km + 0.28 x 19 optimal min) x 1.0 surge, plus the 0.80 platform fee, plus 0.00 on-optimal-route ERP = 15.32. Charged_total is 26.04, so the refund is 26.04 - 15.32 = 10.72, rounded up to 10.75 payable. That is above the 0.50 de minimis, and at 41.2% of charged_total it is below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome on this claim is a PARTIAL_REFUND.

The $5.50 of CTE ERP the rider complains of is already comprehended inside the POL-RD-02 refund, because the recomputed fare carries only on-optimal-route gantries and the optimal route's ERP is 0.00. Under POL-RD-09(1) that itemised ERP must not be added on top of the 10.72; the rider claims it once, inside the partial refund, and not twice.

No traffic advisory covers this trip. The only advisory artifact, EV-ADVIS-00106-01, is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT (BLOCKING): no LTA advisory names Thomson Rd, the CTE or the Chin Swee tunnel in the 08:29-09:03 window on 17 July 2026. With no advisory naming a segment the optimal route traverses, POL-RD-03 exoneration is unavailable and no part of the excess is excused.

The chat log holds a single message, the rider's question at 08:46:30, 'why we at havelock? bugis is behind us'. It is not an instruction, waypoint_hint is null and no road is named, so POL-RD-04 cannot be run on this record and the message exonerates nothing; at most it is a contemporaneous rider observation, not a driver admission.

Neither endpoint moved: original_pickup and original_dropoff are null, and pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null, so amended_optimal_distance_km is properly null and POL-RD-05 has nothing to re-apply. The deviation is measured against the booked 7.2 km optimal, not against any amended figure.

vehicle_type is RYDE_TAXI, not RYDE_POOL, and solo_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply and the 7.2 km booked optimal stands as the sole comparator for the threshold test.

The burden has shifted to the driver under POL-RD-08 and nothing on the record answers it: counterparty_statement is null, and no artifact supports POL-RD-03, POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05, POL-RD-11 or POL-RD-12 on this trip. An assertion unsupported by an artifact ID carries no weight and is discarded.

rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 1, so the enhanced-corroboration condition in POL-RD-08 (4 or more claims with 1 or fewer substantiated) does not fire and this claim is not put to any additional corroboration requirement beyond the trace itself.

The rider does not overreach on materiality: the excess sits at 49.72%, just short of the 50% materiality line, and 3.58 km is far short of 8.0 km, so this is an established but non-material deviation. The rider therefore claims no POL-RD-06 material-deviation uplift, and the refund is the POL-RD-02 arithmetic of 10.72 (rounded 10.75).

No POL-RD-10 trigger fires, so a monetary ruling issues rather than an escalation: the identifiers on all three core artifacts match, the trace is unimpaired so limb (3) is not engaged, the refund of 10.72 is far below the SGD 150.00 ceiling, and limb (5) is not engaged because no exculpatory clause has been invoked against the missing advisory. The missing advisory is cited here for the absence of a driver defence, not as a defence.

claims.text: The deviation is real but it is NOT material, and the driver concedes only the establishment point. The governing trace distance is 10.78 km against an optimal of 7.2 km, an excess of 3.58 km, or 49.72% of optimal. POL-RD-01 makes a deviation MATERIAL only where the excess is greater than 50% of the optimal distance or greater than 8.0 km absolute. 49.72% fails the first limb and 3.58 km fails the second by a wide margin. No materiality finding can attach to this trip.

POL-RD-01 fixes the distance test on gps_trace.trace_distance_km (10.78 km) and expressly bars trip_record.actual_distance_km (10.8 km) from the threshold test, calling it a rounded convenience copy. On the governing figure the excess is 49.72%; even on the barred copy, 3.6 km against 7.2 km is exactly 50.0%, which is not 'greater than 50%'. The rounded trip-record figure cannot be used to manufacture materiality.

No repeat-deviation pattern is established, so neither the FULL_REFUND uplift nor the POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral is available. Under POL-GEN-01 the only citable fields for this test are driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d and driver_profile.completed_trips_90d. deviation_flags_90d is 0, below the 3-flag trigger, and 0 divided by 96 completed trips is 0.000, below the 0.05 ratio trigger. POL-RD-06 is simply not engaged on this record.

Any refund on this trip is arithmetic and capped. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 7.2 + 0.28 x 19.0) x 1.0 + 0.80 = 15.32; refund = 26.04 - 15.32 = 10.72, rounded up to 10.75. That is 41.2% of charged_total, far below the 90% full-refund share, so the ceiling on the case is at most a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 10.75, not the SGD 26.04 the rider frames in the claim.

The SGD 5.50 of CTE ERP the rider asks for is already comprehended inside the POL-RD-02 figure, because that recomputation credits only gantries on the optimal route and the optimal Thomson Road routing carries zero ERP. POL-RD-09(1) is explicit that off-route ERP is already comprehended in the POL-RD-02 refund and must NEVER be added on top of it. The rider cannot recover the two gantry charges as a separate, additional line, and doing so would double-count the same money.

There is no billing-integrity defect for the rider to lean on and none to refer. Both charged gantries are matched to the trace: the CTE (Braddell Rd towards City) gantry has a nearest fix 0.0 m away and the CTE (Chin Swee Rd tunnel) gantry a nearest fix 24.1 m away, each well inside the 250 m crossing radius POL-RD-09 sets. No gantry line is a phantom, so no POL-RD-09(4) referral and no POL-RD-10(8) escalation arises from these lines.

Against the booked optimal of 7.2 km the excess is 3.58 km, or 49.72% of optimal. That clears both establishment limbs (greater than 20% of optimal and greater than 0.8 km), so the route deviation is ESTABLISHED. The trace is unimpaired for policy purposes (169 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, empty gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0), so none of POL-RD-07(a)–(c) fires and no independent corroboration is required.

MATERIALITY (POL-RD-01 / POL-RD-06): The deviation is not MATERIAL. 49.72% does not exceed 50%, and 3.58 km is far short of 8.0 km (even on the barred 10.8 km copy the excess is exactly 50.0%, which is still not 'greater than 50%'). POL-RD-06 is therefore not engaged: there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral.

EXONERATION: None applies. The only traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-00106-01) is MISSING — weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, BLOCKING — and names no segment the optimal route traverses, so POL-RD-03 exonerates nothing. The single chat message is the rider's own question at 08:46:30 with waypoint_hint null, not an instruction, so POL-RD-04 cannot be run on this record. No endpoint was amended (POL-RD-05), and the vehicle is RYDE_TAXI, not a pooled trip (POL-RD-12).

REFUND (POL-RD-02, METERED fare): recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 × 7.2 + 0.28 × 19.0) × 1.0 surge + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 on-optimal-route ERP = 15.32. charged_total = 26.04. Refund = 26.04 − 15.32 = 10.72, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 = 10.75. That is above the 0.50 de-minimis and is 41.2% of charged_total, below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 10.75. The SGD 26.04 the rider's filing asks for is not available: the refund is arithmetic, not discretionary.

ERP (POL-RD-09): The SGD 5.50 of CTE ERP is ALREADY COMPREHENDED inside the 10.72/10.75 refund, because the recomputed fare credits only on-optimal-route gantries and the optimal Thomson Road routing carries 0.00 ERP. Under POL-RD-09(1) it is itemised for transparency but is never added on top. Both gantries are matched to the trace within the 250 m radius (nearest fixes 0.0 m at 08:40:55 and 24.1 m at 08:52:45), so there is no phantom line, no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity referral and no POL-RD-10(8) escalation.

Two rider claims that cited the missing advisory without disclosing its impairment and issue code were discarded by the referee; they are recorded in the audit and are not relied on. ruling.explanation:
Both sides largely agree on the numbers, and the record bears that out. The booked optimal route (Toa Payoh to Bugis via Thomson Rd, routing-engine-v3.2) is 7.2 km and 19 minutes. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00106, weight 1.0, no issues, 169 fixes at 10 s intervals, 100% coverage, no gaps) records 10.78 km over 28 minutes — an excess of 3.58 km, or 49.72% of optimal. That clears both establishment limbs of POL-RD-01 (more than 20% of optimal and more than 0.8 km), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. It does NOT clear materiality: POL-RD-01 requires more than 50% of optimal or more than 8.0 km, and 49.72% and 3.58 km meet neither limb. (The trip_record's rounded 10.8 km convenience copy is expressly barred from the threshold test by POL-RD-01, and even that figure gives exactly 50.0%, not more.) This is therefore an established but non-material deviation. The driver's contention that materiality fails is accepted, and the rider's concession that no materiality uplift is claimed is accepted: POL-RD-06's driver-profile check is not required, no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral can arise — and on the profile itself deviation_flags_90d is 0 (below the 3-flag trigger) and 0/96 is 0.000 (below the 0.05 ratio trigger), consistent with the drivers' and the rider's point. Neither profile yields an adverse finding; both advocates used only the citable counters.

Because fare_breakdown.fare_model is METERED, the refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02 against the optimal route: (3.80 + 0.75 × 7.2 optimal km + 0.28 × 19.0 optimal min) × 1.0 surge = 14.52, plus the 0.80 platform fee, plus 0.00 ERP for on-optimal-route gantries = recomputed_fare of 15.32. Charged_total was 26.04, so the refund is 26.04 − 15.32 = 10.72, rounded up to SGD 10.75 payable. That is above the 0.50 de-minimis threshold and represents 41.2% of charged_total, below the 90% full-refund share. The outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 10.75. Both advocates' computations to this effect are accepted.

The SGD 5.50 of CTE ERP you were charged (Braddell Rd 3.00 at 08:41:22 and Chin Swee tunnel 2.50 at 08:50:51) is itemised here for transparency but is NOT added on top of the refund: under POL-RD-09(1) off-route ERP is already comprehended inside the POL-RD-02 figure, because the recomputed fare credits only gantries lying on the optimal route and the optimal Thomson Road corridor carries none. Charging it twice is not permitted, so the rider's request for the $5.50 as a separate line is declined as double-counting, and the driver's point on the same issue is accepted. Both gantry lines are matched to the trace (nearest fixes 0.0 m and 24.1 m, well inside the 250 m crossing radius), so there is no phantom charge line, no billing-integrity finding and no POL-RD-09(4) referral.

No exculpation applies. There is no traffic advisory covering Thomson Rd, the CTE or the Chin Swee tunnel in the 08:29-09:03 window — EV-ADVIS-00106-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — and its absence is itself citable, so POL-RD-03 exoneration is unavailable to the driver. The single chat message (08:46:30, 'why we at havelock? bugis is behind us') is a rider question, not an instruction: waypoint_hint is null and no road is named, so POL-RD-04 exonerates nothing and the corroboration test cannot be run; at most the message is a contemporaneous observation. Neither endpoint was amended (original_pickup/original_dropoff and both amendment timestamps are null), so POL-RD-05 has nothing to re-apply, and the vehicle is a RYDE_TAXI with solo_optimal_distance_km null, so POL-RD-12's pooled-itinerary baseline does not apply. The 7.2 km booked optimal stands as the sole comparator.

No POL-RD-10 escalation trigger fires. All three core artifacts carry trip_id TRP-00106; the trace is unimpaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c); the refund of 10.72 is far below the SGD 150.00 ceiling and below charged_total; the rider's enhanced-corroboration condition does not fire (deviation_claims_60d is 1, substantiated 1); no exculpatory clause was invoked against the missing advisory; and every charge line (base fare, distance and time charges, platform fee, both ERP gantries) has a counterpart in the trace or trip record. A monetary ruling therefore issues rather than an escalation. Confidence rests on artifacts all at weight 1.0 (the GPS trace, trip record and fare breakdown), so the cap is 1.0.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver: on trip TRP-00106 the route deviation is established, but it is not a material deviation, and the money is settled by the arithmetic, not by discretion.

Distance and threshold (POL-RD-01). The governing measurement is the GPS trace at 10.78 km, against the booked optimal of 7.2 km. The trip record's 10.8 km is a rounded convenience copy and was not used for the threshold test. The excess is 3.58 km, or 49.72% of optimal. That clears establishment (over 20% and over 0.8 km) but not materiality, whose lines are over 50% of optimal or over 8.0 km; 49.72% and 3.58 km are both short. The rider correctly claims no materiality uplift and the driver correctly concedes only the establishment point. The trace is unimpaired (169 fixes at a 10 s interval, 100% coverage, no gap over 90 s and no jump over 500 m), so the deviation stands on the trace alone and no POL-RD-07 corroboration requirement arises.

Refund (POL-RD-02, METERED). recomputed_fare = (3.80 base fare + 0.75 x 7.2 km = 5.40 + 0.28 x 19.0 min = 5.32) x 1.0 surge + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 optimal-route ERP = 15.32. charged_total = 26.04. Refund = 26.04 - 15.32 = 10.72, rounded up to 10.75. That is above the 0.50 de minimis and is 41.2% of the charge, below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 10.75. The rider's filed figure of $26.04 is not granted: the most the arithmetic yields is 10.75.

ERP (POL-RD-09). The two CTE gantries the rider objects to (Braddell Rd $3.00 and Chin Swee tunnel $2.50, $5.50 in total) are off the optimal route. That $5.50 is already comprehended inside the 10.75, because the recomputed fare credits only on-optimal-route gantries and the optimal Thomson Rd routing carries none; POL-RD-09(1) forbids adding that itemised ERP on top of the refund. The rider recovers it once, inside the partial refund, not twice. Both gantries are matched to the trace (nearest fixes 0.0 m and 24.1 m, inside the 250 m crossing radius), so there is no phantom line and no POL-RD-09(4) referral, and POL-RD-10(8) is not engaged.

ruling.explanation:
Route-deviation dispute over the Toa Payoh to Bugis taxi trip of 17 July 2026. Both sides agree the deviation is established; they disagree on how much money moves.

Deviation (POL-RD-01). The governing distance is the gps_trace polyline, trace_distance_km = 10.78 km, and not the trip record's rounded 10.8 km convenience copy, which POL-RD-01 expressly bars from the threshold test. The booked optimal is 7.2 km. Excess = 3.58 km, i.e. 49.72% of optimal. That clears the establishment test on both limbs (greater than 20% of optimal and greater than 0.8 km absolute), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. The rider's claim is accepted on this point; the driver's concession is recorded.

Materiality. 49.72% is not GREATER than 50%, and 3.58 km is far short of 8.0 km. The deviation is therefore NOT material. The driver is right that no materiality finding attaches — even the barred 10.8 km trip-record copy gives 3.6/7.2 = exactly 50.0%, which is still not 'greater than 50%', so the rounded figure cannot manufacture materiality. The rider is right not to claim the POL-RD-06 uplift. Because the deviation is not material, the driver_profile check is not triggered; in any event no pattern is established (deviation_flags_90d = 0 of 96 completed trips = 0.000), so no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral. The rider's own profile figures confirm the POL-RD-08 enhanced-corroboration condition does not fire (deviation_claims_60d = 1, substantiated = 1).

Exoneration. None applies. No traffic advisory covers Thomson Rd, the CTE or the Chin Swee tunnel: EV-ADVIS-00106-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT (BLOCKING), so POL-RD-03 cannot run and no part of the excess is excused. The single chat message of 08:46:30 ('why we at havelock? bugis is behind us') is a rider question, not an instruction; waypoint_hint is null and no road is named, so POL-RD-04's corroboration test cannot be run and the message exonerates nothing (it is a contemporaneous rider observation, not a driver admission). Neither endpoint was amended, so POL-RD-05 has nothing to re-apply; the vehicle is RYDE_TAXI, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply; and the fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-11 does not apply.

Trace integrity (POL-RD-07). The gps_trace is unimpaired for policy purposes: 169 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, max_gap_sec 0.0, empty gaps list. None of limbs (a) to (c) fires, so the deviation stands on the trace alone and no independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) is required; no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arises.

Refund (POL-RD-02). recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 7.2 optimal km + 0.28 x 19.0 optimal min) x 1.0 surge) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 on-optimal-route ERP + 0.00 waiting fee - 0.00 promo = (3.80 + 5.40 + 5.32) + 0.80 = 15.32. charged_total = 26.04. Refund = 26.04 - 15.32 = 10.72, rounded up to 10.75 payable. That is above the 0.50 de minimis and is 41.2% of charged_total, below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 10.75. The driver's ceiling argument is accepted; the rider's framing of the full SGD 26.04 is rejected.

ERP (POL-RD-09). The two CTE gantries — Braddell Rd SGD 3.00 and Chin Swee tunnel SGD 2.50, total SGD 5.50 — are off-optimal-route charges (both flagged on_optimal_route false; the booked Thomson Rd / Bukit Timah Rd / Rochor Canal Rd route carries no gantry and SGD 0.00 ERP). POL-RD-09(1) comprehends them inside the POL-RD-02 refund because the recomputed fare credits only the optimal route's ERP. They are itemised here for transparency but must NOT be added on top of the 10.72. Any claim to the SGD 5.50 as a separate additional line is rejected as a double-count of the same money.

Billing integrity. Both gantry charges are matched to the trace — nearest fixes 0.0 m and 24.1 m, well inside the 250 m crossing radius POL-RD-09 uses — so there is no phantom line, no POL-RD-09(4) referral and no POL-RD-10(8) escalation.

Driver compensation. None. The fare_breakdown billed 10.8 km against a 10.78 km trace, so there is no unbilled-distance shortfall and POL-RD-04's compensation limb is not engaged.

Escalation. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: the trip identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown (TRP-00106); the trace is unimpaired; the refund is far below the SGD 150.00 ceiling; no timestamps run backwards; no exculpatory clause has been invoked against a missing or non-covering artifact; and no charge line lacks a counterpart. Confidence is 0.95, above the 0.70 floor. The ruling therefore issues as a monetary PARTIAL_REFUND.
